title: Deposit ETH from L1 to L2
summary: Trigger an L1→L2 deposit via OptimismPortal.depositTransaction. The L2 derivation pipeline picks it up after the next sequencer batch.
audience: Anyone exercising the canonical bridge or testing deposit-driven L2 flows.
description:
Pushes a `depositTransaction` directly to the OptimismPortal on L1 from the test account. The deposit appears on L2 once the sequencer derives it from L1 (give it a few blocks, or step the sequencer manually from the Home page).

Useful for confirming the rollup is actually deriving from L1 and not just sequencing locally.

prerequisites.title: Sequencer running
prerequisites.detail: Otherwise the deposit sits in L1 forever.

calls.note: value = msg.value, to = sender, isCreation = false, data = empty
